source: Scryfall oracle-cards bulk 2026-10-12T09:02:38.125+00:00; Commander-legal legendary creatures and 'can be your commander' cards
method: Held-out: 90 commanders rated after the detectors were tuned (45 unrated EDHREC-ranked, 45 random, seeded). Two blind raters tagged every commander with every keyword in commander-profile.golden.md; the splits were settled by its rulings. Voltron truth re-rated 2026-10-13 under R11 (EDHREC Voltron theme share cross-check): 214 voltron-relevant commanders, two fresh blind raters, 9 splits settled by the ruling.
